columns.name: Course Offering ID
columns.description: D2L’s unique identifier for the course offering.

columns.name: Course Offering Code
columns.description: Often the course identifier from an SIS system.

columns.name: Course Offering Name
columns.description: Name of the course offering.

columns.name: Course Section ID
columns.description: D2L’s unique identifier for the section. May contain a list if there are multiple sections.

columns.name: Course Section Code
columns.description: Client defined code for the section. May contain a list if there are multiple sections.

columns.name: Course Section Name
columns.description: Name of the section. May contain a list if there are multiple sections.

columns.name: Semester ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Semester that the course offering belongs to. May contain a list if there are multiple sections.

columns.name: Semester Code
columns.description: Unique code for the semester that the course offering belongs to. May contain a list if there are multiple sections.

columns.name: Semester Name
columns.description: Semester that the course offering belongs to. May contain a list if there are multiple sections.

columns.name: User ID
columns.description: D2L’s unique identifier for the user.

columns.name: User Name
columns.description: User’s username.

columns.name: Org Defined ID
columns.description: User’s Org Defined Id (often the learner identifier from an SIS system).

columns.name: First Name
columns.description: User’s first name.

columns.name: Last Name
columns.description: User’s last name.

columns.name: Role ID
columns.description: User’s role Id at the specific course offering.

columns.name: Role Name
columns.description: User’s role at the specific course offering.

columns.name: Content Topic ID
columns.description: D2L’s unique identifier for the content topic.

columns.name: Content Topic Name
columns.description: Name of the content topic.

columns.name: Module ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the module. This only displays output from the direct parent.

columns.name: Module Name
columns.description: Name of the module. This only displays output from the direct parent

columns.name: Content Topic Visits
columns.description: Number of visits the user made to topics in the org.

columns.name: Total Time Spent
columns.description: Time in seconds the user spent in the topics in the org.

columns.name: Last Visited Date
columns.description: Last date/time a user accessed the course content.
